niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” CTV advertising agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, geography, and whether you need creative, programmatic buying, measurement, or full-service strategy.

To help you choose, tell me a few quick things (I can then recommend specific agencies):
- Where are you running the campaign (US, EMEA, APAC, global)?
- Monthly / campaign budget range
- Primary goal (brand awareness, reach, direct response/ROAS, lead gen)
- Do you need creative production or only media buying?
- Do you want programmatic DSP buying, direct-platform buys (Roku/Hulu/etc.), or a hybrid?

How to pick the best agency (key criteria)
- Platform expertise: proven experience on Roku, Hulu, Amazon Fire TV, The Trade Desk/DV360, Samsung TV Plus, etc.
- Buying approach: programmatic vs direct-sold vs guaranteed (impacts reach, price and control)
- Measurement & attribution: third-party validation (Nielsen, IAS, tvSquared), cross-device matching, incrementality testing
- Creative capabilities: CTV-optimized creative, dynamic video, A/B testing
- Data & targeting: use of first-/third-party data, household-level targeting, audience modeling
- Transparency & reporting: clear fees, access to raw data / dashboards
- Case studies: measurable results in your category or similar KPIs
- Platform relationships: direct partnerships or prioritized access can improve inventory and pricing

Types of agencies and examples
- Large holding networks (best for scale, global buys, full-service): OMD / PHD (Omnicom), Mindshare / MediaCom (WPP), Starcom / Zenith (Publicis), Initiative / UM (IPG)
- Specialist CTV/OTT agencies or providers (deep CTV expertise, often more agile): MNTN (performance-focused CTV), Simulmedia (audience planning & TV addressability), Tremor Video, Cadent, 605 (OTT-focused agencies vary by market)
- Tech/platform partners (not traditional agencies but important partners): The Trade Desk, Roku Advertising, Amazon DSP, DV360 — some offer managed services or certified partner agencies
- Creative/ad-tech partners: Innovid, VideoAmp, TVSquared for measurement/creative optimization

If you give me the details above I’ll shortlist 2–4 agencies that fit your needs (and one low-cost in-house approach if you want to test CTV without a large agency).
